title: The Pour Service Section feature map
inventory_meaning: Rows identify source functions, overlapping geometry, materials or process conditions. A source family occurs once in its native role; true mates remain paired. Layer/seam bands and three per-object support roofs are intentional comparisons.

service_review.scope: Current source-bound sampled nominal rigid service and capture review. Physical handling, force and inversion remain unmeasured.

source_routing.scope: Source line-section specification: upstream 6.35 mm supply tail and separate downstream 9.525 mm soda neck tube.

physical_scope: Unprinted service-section integration. Native source observations retain their recorded scopes; CAD and native slice establish geometry and deposited paths, not release, force, finish, sealing or lifetime.
coordinate_convention: World +Y is toward the rear; +Z is upward. Manufacturing Z is local STL bed-up and can oppose world Z. Fit numbers identify their per-face, diametral or vertical convention.
native_recipe_authority: Prepared native print plan and its exact archive bindings supply the final band/material recipes. Geometry-only defaults are not substituted for the actual prepared plan.

grip.scope: Identified receiver coupons: support removal and assembled grip fit accepted. No lifting-load, retention-force or flexing-life result.

tee_surface.scope: Identified additive lower tee surface accepted; this is a surface observation.

tee_slide.scope: Identified carrier slides well with less tilt at 1.00 mm roof / 0.25 mm floor air. Spring return and simultaneous collet actuation unmeasured.

nameplate_fit.scope: Identified flat-wing plate and receiver fit accepted at 0.15 mm body side / 0.25 mm centered wing-tip / 0.45 mm wing-thickness air.

nameplate_art.scope: Identified face-up raised artwork appearance accepted. Current plate scan and full drawer integration unprinted.

display.scope: Identified face-up bezel and receiver coupon accepted with residual bow; shake passed. Full facet/gasket/backer assembly unprinted.

pump.scope: Identified two-pump holder held both pumps firmly with no vertical play. Current single-pump crop and drawer integration unprinted.

pogo.scope: Printed test-piece connector fit and mating/compression accepted. Installed numeric travel, continuity, resistance and life unmeasured.

magnet_fit.scope: C3 RC62 pocket and V69 valve socket hand fits selected on the identified samples. New paused closures and installed retention unmeasured.

magnet_roof.scope: Identified H2C first covering layer over the magnet has accepted appearance. Finished closure and retention force unmeasured.

industrial.scope: Identified complete Industrial print accepted for shipping and appearance. Lifting on supported layers and noticeable seam are accepted observations. Hybrid foot and comparison bands have no new physical result.

cover.scope: Identified complete broad-wall PET-GF cover fit and retention accepted. The current relaxed reference cover is unprinted; no force or cycle-life value.

lever.scope: Identified white PET-GF side-down lever fit and operation accepted. Current printed dimensional donor alignment and force unmeasured.

organizer.scope: 6.65 mm beverage bore and 4.40 mm drain bore selected separately with their existing chamfer/contact geometry. Current combined row, signal slot and installation unprinted.

thimble.scope: Reported source tube fit; actual saved source recipe is separate. Current printed nominal donor, pressure sealing, creep and capture unmeasured.

ports.scope: Identified TAP/FLAVOR raised lettering and finish accepted; mounting fit not separately reported.

co2.scope: Photo records clear white letters on red with no visible offset; no separate mounting verdict.

c14.scope: Printed inlet/C13-cord station accepted; exact physical scope is separate from this relocated native tunnel.

funnel.scope: Source replacement rail/receiver has native clearance evidence. Current compact complete active quadrant and physical support cleanup/fit unprinted.
